answer_1.quote: We validate our approach on multiple sequence generation tasks. For neural machine translation, we train our model from scratch. For other tasks, we first perform pre-training using our methods on BART-base to obtain BART-JANUS, then use the downstream task to finetune the BART-JANUS. GLGE We use the GLGE (General Language Generation Evaluation Benchmark) to evaluate the ability of BART-JANUS on sequence generation tasks. We selected three different tasks: Abstractive Text Summarization dataset Xsum (227K article and summary pairs), Answer-aware Question Generation dataset SQuAD 1.1 (98K answer, passage, and question data triples), and Conversational Question Answering dataset PersonaChat (150k persona profile, conversation history, and response data triples).
